articles.title: Lender Letter LL-2026-09 Manual Underwriting Eligibility
articles.summary: Fannie Mae revised the Eligibility Matrix for manually underwritten loans sold on or after February 22, 2027. The letter addresses credit scores, reserves, two- to four-unit principal residences, cash-out refinancing, and consolidation of manual-underwriting requirements.
articles.mortgageRelevance: Changes to manual mortgage underwriting eligibility and loan-delivery requirements.

articles.title: Announcement SEL-2026-10: Selling Guide Updates

articles.title: Privacy Act of 1974; Matching Program
articles.summary: In accordance with the Privacy Act of 1974, as amended, the Department of Housing and Urban Development (HUD) and the Social Security Administration (SSA) are providing notice of a new computer matching program. Under this program, SSA will disclose Social Security Number (SSN) verifications to the Federal Housing Administration (FHA) through HUD to verify Borrowers' eligibility to participate in FHA's Single Family mortgage insurance programs. The matching program will enable HUD to verify Social Security numbers and related identifying information submitted by individuals applying for FHA-insured mortgage programs.
articles.mortgageRelevance: FHA mortgage borrower eligibility verification and the HUD/SSA matching program.

articles.title: Single Family Housing Guaranteed Loan Program-Income Producing Accessory Dwelling Unit (ADU) Provisions
articles.summary: The Rural Housing Service (RHS or the Agency), a Rural Development (RD) agency of the United States Department of Agriculture (USDA), is amending the Single Family Housing Guaranteed Loan Program (SFHGLP) regulation to permit the financing of single family homes with income producing Accessory Dwelling Units (ADUs) and clarify the eligibility of properties with features designed to accommodate home- based operations using non-commercial real estate features.
articles.mortgageRelevance: Final USDA mortgage property-eligibility rule for income-producing accessory dwelling units.
